name: save-boot-22b-materia-equip-plan
description: #241 (acceptance 2): a pad sequence puts a materia into Cloud's weapon slot 0, by pad input only, confirmed by reading the savemap. As 22a (planned move to Materia, Circle until menu_ovl reads 3, 120 frames), mark, Circle (weapon materia slot 0, where the cursor is assumed to start), 60 frames, Circle (the first entry of the materia list, assumed to be inventory slot 0), then wait until wm0 reads 0x31 (eq_wait; timeout 120), then 30 frames. Checks: wm0 0x31 (mat_ok) and changed since the mark; still on overlay 3 in the menu; field unchanged; a rerun matches (match). Reports the raw wm0 and mat0 (author-chosen words, or 0xFFFFFFFF empty: where the materia went) and menu_ovl. Only frame counts, 1/0 and these values leave.
